body: @sepo-agent /answer Let's check how the dark mode is set up in the repo ? and let's plan to fix the recent UI changes to make it work better for dark mode.

comments.body:
Here's a full breakdown of how dark mode is currently set up and where it's breaking.

---

## How Dark Mode Works

**Strategy**: Attribute-based theme switching via `:root[saved-theme="dark"]`.

**Key files:**
| File | Role |
|---|---|
| [`quartz/util/theme.ts`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/util/theme.ts) | Generates `:root` and `:root[saved-theme="dark"]` CSS variable blocks |
| [`quartz.config.ts`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz.config.ts#L31-L51) | Defines all light/dark color tokens |
| [`quartz/components/scripts/darkmode.inline.ts`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/components/scripts/darkmode.inline.ts) | Sets `saved-theme` attribute before DOM renders (prevents flash) |
| [`quartz/styles/custom.scss`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/styles/custom.scss) | All the recent card/layout UI — primary place for issues |

**Variable switching**: `theme.ts` outputs this at build time:
```css
:root { --light: #fdfcfa; --dark: #2d2926; ... }
:root[saved-theme="dark"] { --light: #1c1a18; --dark: #f5f2ed; ... }
```
Everything in `custom.scss` uses `var(--light)`, `var(--lightgray)`, etc. — so it **should** switch automatically. Mostly it does. But there are two concrete problems.

---

## Issues Found

### 1. `--episode-card-bg` is hardcoded — breaks episode pages in dark mode (critical)

[`custom.scss` line 55](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/styles/custom.scss#L55):

```scss
body[data-slug^="episodes/"] {
  --episode-card-bg: #fffefc;  // ← hardcoded near-white, never switches!
}
```

This variable is used for the background of the episode center content, sidebar widgets, and explorer. In dark mode, text becomes `#d4cfc8` (light) but the background stays `#fffefc` (near-white) — making text nearly invisible. Every other page uses `var(--light)` directly so they're fine.

**Fix**: Replace the hardcoded value with `var(--light)` (the values are nearly identical in light mode — `#fffefc` vs `#fdfcfa`):

```scss
body[data-slug^="episodes/"] {
  --episode-card-bg: var(--light);  // inherits dark mode switch automatically
}
```

### 2. Box shadows use hardcoded dark colors — invisible in dark mode (cosmetic)

All the card `box-shadow` values use `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03)` etc. On a dark `#1c1a18` background, a dark shadow is essentially invisible — cards lose their depth. In dark mode, shadows typically need to use lighter colors or the border alone needs to carry the separation.

---

## Proposed Fix Plan

**Step 1** — Fix `--episode-card-bg` (1-line change in `custom.scss` line 55):
```scss
// Before
--episode-card-bg: #fffefc;
// After
--episode-card-bg: var(--light);
```

**Step 2** — Add a dark mode shadow override block in `custom.scss`:
```scss
:root[saved-theme="dark"] {
  .sidebar .backlinks,
  .sidebar .toc,
  .sidebar .graph,
  .sidebar .recent-notes,
  .explorer,
  .page > #quartz-body .center,
  footer {
    box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04),
                0 2px 8px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
  }
}
```
(Or use the existing `border: 1px solid var(--lightgray)` alone for separation, which already switches correctly.)

**Step 3** — Verify the dot pattern background:
```scss
body {
  background-image: radial-gradient(circle, var(--gray) 1px, transparent 1px);
}
```
`var(--gray)` does switch in dark mode (`#8a847d` → `#5c5650`), so this should be OK.

---

## Questions Before I Code

1. **Episode page intent**: Was `--episode-card-bg: #fffefc` meant to be slightly distinct from the regular `--light` background? If yes, we can add a dark mode override separately rather than collapsing it to `var(--light)`.
2. **Shadows**: Should dark mode cards keep their `border` only (cleaner), or use a light/inverted shadow for more depth?
3. **Scope**: Should I address anything else visible in the screenshot? (I can see the image dimensions but not the full details — a screenshot of what specifically looks broken would help me prioritize.)

**Sepo implementation finished**

- Branch: `agent/implement-issue-19/claude-25134374609`
- Pull request: https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/pull/26

Fixed two dark mode issues in custom.scss. First, changed --episode-card-bg from the hardcoded near-white #fffefc to var(--light) so episode pages correctly use the dark background in dark mode instead of showing light text on a white card. Second, added a :root[saved-theme="dark"] block that strips the invisible dark box-shadows (rgba(0,0,0,...)) from all card elements — in dark mode the existing var(--lightgray) borders already provide visual separation.
